title: Jev go/no-go: price a 500-bio subsample
description: Price and cap a Jev run on a 500-bio subsample of the regulated-decisions pool before any request goes out, per the free-engines-before-paid-ones convention, then decide go/no-go on the full ~24,000-request run described in docs/regulated-decisions-preregistration.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Jev go/no-go prices a 500-bio subsample

Scenario: A dry-run price and cap gate the full regulated-decisions run
  Given the free-engines-before-paid-ones convention and docs/regulated-decisions-preregistration.md's ~24,000-request full run
  When I run a Jev dry-run price on a 500-bio subsample of the regulated-decisions pool
  Then the price and a request cap are recorded and approved before any full Jev request is sent

right_now_summary: A 500-bio Jev dry run will set the price and request cap before the full run.
